question: 累计消费金额超过全平台用户平均累计消费3倍的用户有哪些？（请给出用户名与累计非取消实付金额）
gold_sql: WITH user_spent AS (SELECT o.user_id AS uid, SUM(o.total_amount) AS spent FROM orders o WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.user_id) SELECT u.username, ROUND(us.spent, 2) AS total_spent FROM user_spent us JOIN users u ON u.id = us.uid GROUP BY u.id, u.username, us.spent HAVING us.spent > 3 * (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM user_spent) ORDER BY total_spent DESC, u.id
notes: Task 13 评测失败自动沉淀；供 Task 14 分析
